text: Production review of A gentle seated start.
This draft has not been professionally approved and is not for exercise use.
The proposed session begins with a stable chair or wall, a clear space, and a comfortable pace.
The reviewer must confirm the movements, alternatives and timing before filming.
Sit tall, feet resting on the floor.
Lift one bent knee a little, lower slowly, then change legs.
The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer.
There is no target to chase.
Holding the chair, extend one leg comfortably.
Point the toes away, then draw them back.
Return the foot to the floor before changing sides.
This is the proposed closing section.
The final instructor will guide a comfortable finish and remind the viewer that resting or doing less is welcome.
The session remains awaiting professional approval.
